thread:
Eli (CSM): Hi team — kicking off Lark Finance activation. High-level ask: align stakeholders, call out non-negotiable constraints, and agree a 6–8 week milestone plan. Drop any blockers for Week 0.
Sam (Lark PM): Hi all, thanks Eli. Stakeholders: Sam (PM), Priya (Security), Mark (Platform Eng), Jo (Data Lead). Constraint: EU data residency only, no external analytics vendors, and no S3-compatible public buckets.
Priya (Lark Sec): Security items: must use customer KMS, full audit logs, and no plaintext model payload storage. We need to review our SOC2 artifact pack before prod.
Diego (Solutions Eng): EU residency noted. Two options: Redwood Private in customer VPC or Dedicated with EU-only nodes. For initial staging we can use masked data in our EU dev cluster. I'll sketch both infra options.
Zoe (AE): Renewal context: upsell opportunity at 9 months. Early adoption KPI we care about: 25% of targeted workflows using model within 30 days of handoff. If pilot misses SLAs, renewal becomes renegotiation risk.
Eli (CSM): Proposed success criteria (initial): 1) Staging E2E calls working with masked data, 2) median latency < 350ms on 256-token typical calls, 3) quality baseline: >= 80% pass on Lark's 40-case eval set, 4) enablement completed and runbook accepted. Thoughts?
Sam (Lark PM): Those look good. One more: throughput gating — support 40rps peak for user-facing flows.
Diego (Solutions Eng): I'll add throughput target: p95 < 700ms at 40rps on staging. If we fail, next step is dedicated capacity or batching adjustments.
Priya (Lark Sec): Compliance timeline: security review occurs in 3 weeks. If any findings, prod could be delayed 1–2 weeks. Recommend we treat staging validation as independent from prod gating.
Eli (CSM): Agree — staging first. Proposed timeline: Week 0: networking + creds; Week 1: model pull + eval harness; Week 2: internal smoke tests; Week 3: pilot with 5% traffic; Week 4: tuning; Week 5: enablement + feedback capture; Week 6: handoff. (Stretch to Week 8 if legal adds delay.)
Diego (Solutions Eng): I can own Week 0–2. Deliverables: architecture doc, infra scripts, eval harness. Will post a short arch diagram and a sample terraform snippet by EOD Thursday.
Zoe (AE): I'll prepare customer-facing metrics dashboard and renewal watchlist. Action: list the key adoption metrics we want to track post-handoff.
Eli (CSM): Enablement plan: 60–90 min workshop + 30-min ops drill. Deliverables: runbook, quickstart repo, short ops checklist. Also run a short Typeform (5 q) after pilot for qualitative feedback and a one-question CSAT.
Sam (Lark PM): Attendees for enablement: 2 PMs, 2 Platform Engs, 1 Data Owner. I'll send calendar invites after Eli confirms the date.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Quick checklist (I'll keep updated):
```
- network: confirm VPC CIDRs and peering
- creds: service account + KMS role
- data: masked sample dataset (<= 2k rows)
- eval: 40 canonical prompts from Lark
- observability: token-level cost + latency traces
```
Priya (Lark Sec): Add: audit log forwarding to customer SIEM, and no model artifacts stored unencrypted.
Eli (CSM): Communication cadence: weekly 30-min sync (Thurs 9am CET) + this thread for async. If blocker, prefix with [BLOCKER].
scheduler-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Lark Activation Weekly" Thu 09:00 CET — invites sent.
Zoe (AE): Commercial note: flag me if integration slips past Week 8 or if quality < 75% on the eval set. I'll prep talking points for renewal risk discussion.
Sam (Lark PM): Thanks — we'll prioritize masked data handoff this week. Also, small ask: can you confirm whether embeddings are required? Some teams want retrieval use-cases.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Yes — retrieval + rerank in scope. Will include embedding tests in the eval harness.
Eli (CSM): Action items recap: Diego: infra options + terraform snippet by Thu; Sam: confirm attendee list and embedding requirement; Priya: SOC2 artifact list & compliance calendar; Zoe: renewal metric dashboard template; I'll book enablement slot in Week 5 and own feedback form.
Sam (Lark PM): Looping in Mark (Platform Eng) offline to coordinate peering windows.
Priya (Lark Sec): I'll upload artifact baseline to the shared drive by next Tue.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Ping me for test tokens or sample logs.
Eli (CSM): Thanks team — prioritize staging so we can validate performance before compliance gating. Keep this thread updated. :raised_hands:
